info.name: United HRMS - Identity + Employees
info.description: Authentication/RBAC (Identity, Phase 5), Employee CRUD (Employee module, Phase 6), Leave Management (Phase 8), and the generic Approval Engine (Phase 9) endpoints. Run requests top-to-bottom within each folder. Folder 6 (Employee Management) requires the access_token captured by folder 2's 'Login (Admin)' request, and a department_id — see that folder's first request for how to fetch one. Folder 7 (Leave Management) also sets up and Telegram-links a manager for folder 8 (Approvals) to decide requests as. Folder 8 additionally requires the 'internal_service_key' collection variable to match your .env's INTERNAL_SERVICE_API_KEY, and a manual OTP-fetch step from the backend logs (see folder 7's 'Link Manager Telegram - Request OTP' request).
